provenance: Eleven individually painted condensed essence icons generated with built-in imagegen. Generated alpha is preserved when resampled with Lanczos and composited over the standard dark teal inventory backing. Original paintings remain unchanged; replacements name the exact prior cell hash.
productionMode: faithful style recreation for inventory icons; new essence forms
promptPrefix: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one Rabbit Lands fantasy inventory icon. Paint ONE elemental ESSENCE as a compact self-contained magical droplet or dense wisp with a clear sculptural silhouette, not a potion bottle. Chunky hand-painted Oldcraft storybook fantasy, broad simplified planes, rich matte pigment, restrained highlights, warm organic color relationships, purposeful detail that reads at 50x50 pixels. The essence is the only subject, centered with 15 percent clear margin on every side on a square canvas. No container, glass, cork, vial, platform, scenery, cast shadow, frame, border, letters, words, numbers, logos, decorative star field or additional objects. True transparent background and clean alpha. Contain all subtle luminosity inside the silhouette; avoid diffuse bloom.
